explanation: Son of King David and Bathsheba, chosen by God to build the temple in Jerusalem.
A holy place for worshiping God, planned by King David and built by his son Solomon.
A country north of Israel, known for its cedar trees that were used to build the temple.
Large, fragrant trees with durable wood, brought from Lebanon to build the temple.
Workers from King Hiram of Tyre who helped Solomon build the temple.
Metal used in the construction of the temple, especially for making tools and decorations.
A time without war or conflict, which God promised David that Solomon would experience during his reign.
Another name for God, the almighty Creator.
